input_vague: necesito nombre para nuestra nueva herramienta de optimización de prompts
output_optimal:
<role>Brand naming strategist for dev-tool products. Knows -ify/-ly/AI dates a product in 6 months.</role>

<brief>
Product: Prompt optimization tool for developers. Senior engineers, AI engineers, tech leads.
Tone: Confident, technical, dry humor. Not corporate. Not cute. Not AI-first.
Length: 1-3 syllables. Pronounceable in EN and ES.
</brief>

<constraints>
- Length: 4-10 characters.
- 1-3 syllables.
- No -ify, -ly, -ai, -gpt, -prompt suffixes.
- No portmanteau of "prompt" + anything.
- Works as noun and verb.
</constraints>

<anti_cliche_blacklist>
AI-aesthetic: spark, mind, brain, neural, smart, sage, oracle, nova, lumen.
Generic suffixes: -ify, -ly, -kit, -box, -hub, -lab, -studio.
Greek/Roman gods. Intelligence animals. Refine/forge/craft synonyms.
</anti_cliche_blacklist>

<generation_protocol>
1. Generate 12 candidates across 5 mechanisms (concrete object, verb from physics, reclaimed English word, bilingual EN/ES, brutally short non-word).
2. Reject 4 most obvious. Document why.
3. Develop top 4 with etymology, positioning, sample usage, risk.
4. Self-critique: which would a competitor arrive at within 6 months? Cut those.
</generation_protocol>

<output_format>
Recommended (1). Alternatives (2). Rejected with reasoning (4-6). Next steps (domain check, trademark, reaction test).
</output_format>

<forbidden_output>
- Names with "AI", "GPT", "prompt", "craft", "forge", "smart".
- Generic adjective stacks.
- Names requiring etymology explanation.
</forbidden_output>
why_excellent: Constraints duros. Anti-cliché por subdominio. Generation protocol con 5 mecanismos. Reject-obvious. Self-critique con criterio falsificable.
